cross_checks_and_corrections: Android SPKI pin is not DER certificate pin; expiration must not silently bypass the exact-pin requirement
Python PEM loader cannot directly consume keytool PKCS12; standard JDK encoding APIs support a conversion proposal, not a tested converter
Exact certificate check must happen in TLS handshake before any credential/body; normal IP SAN validation remains required
Public-form matching WAN/egress and router menu observation do not prove inbound reachability or fixed IP
Static http.server plus TLS is not production-hardening; every file endpoint needs scoped authorization
R16 INTERNET permission absent; new r17 native transfer must not open WebView network access or old editor/admin
